attchmntText: NAVA LIMITED has informed the Exchange about "resumption of operations of the 60 MW Power Plant at Odisha"
voiceSummary: Nava Limited intimates the resumption of operations of its 60 MW Power Plant at Odisha with effect from November 14, 2026. This follows the successful completion of routine inspection, maintenance, and overhauling activities that necessitated a temporary shutdown. The company previously communicated this shutdown via letter NAVA/SECTL/188/2026-27 dated September 04, 2026. The 60 MW unit is part of an aggregate installed capacity of 150 MW. The operations have resumed in compliance with applicable safety and regulatory requirements.

attchmntText: Solex Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Solex Energy Limited filed an investor presentation for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported total income of 2,743 million rupees and EBITDA of 284 million rupees for Q2 FY27. Profit after tax was 39 million rupees. For H1 FY27, total income was 5,399 million rupees and EBITDA was 622 million rupees. The firm has a module manufacturing capacity of 4 GW. It is planning a 2.2 GW solar cell manufacturing line. The order book visibility stands at approximately 4,000 crore rupees. Dr. Chetan Shah serves as Chairman and Managing Director with DIN 02253886.

attchmntText: The Belrise Industries Limited has submitted to the exchange monitoring agency report of IPO and QIP for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Belrise Industries Limited submitted the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by Crisil Ratings Limited. The report details the utilization of proceeds from the Initial Public Offer. The company fully repaid outstanding borrowings amounting to Rs 15,960.21 million. No utilization occurred during the reported quarter for general corporate purposes. Unutilized proceeds of Rs 4.61 million remain for general corporate purposes. Issue expenses utilized Rs 785.71 million, leaving Rs 63.62 million unutilized. The total unutilized amount stands at Rs 68.23 million. The report confirms no deviation from the objects disclosed in the Offer Document. Shareholder approval for material deviations was not applicable. The monitoring agency verified the utilization through peer-reviewed independent chartered accountant certificates and bank statements.

attchmntText: Innovision Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Innovision Limited submitted newspaper advertisements to the BSE and NSE on 14th November 2026. These advertisements were published pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. The publication relates to the outcome of the Board Meeting held on 13th November 2026. During this meeting, the Board approved and took on record the Unaudited Financial Results. These results cover both Standalone and Consolidated figures. The period under review is the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The advertisements appeared in Financial Express and Jansatta.

attchmntText: Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Solarworld Energy Solutions Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, received from Crisil Ratings Limited on November 13, 2026. The report covers the utilization of proceeds from the Initial Public Offer and Pre-IPO, totaling Rs 5,500.00 million. Crisil Ratings Limited reported no deviation in the utilization of funds towards the original objects. However, the company revised the object of the issue pursuant to shareholder approval obtained through a special resolution. The unutilized proceeds are proposed to be deployed towards the revised object in forthcoming quarters. The variation is attributed to this change in object approved by shareholders. The IPO was conducted between September 22, 2025, and September 25, 2025, with a gross issue size of Rs 4,400.00 million. The Pre-IPO allotment occurred on November 21, 2024, for Rs 1,100.00 million. The monitoring agency confirmed that all arrangements pertaining to technical assistance and collaboration are in operation.

attchmntText: Sreeleathers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Press Release- financial result Sept 2026".
voiceSummary: Sreeleathers Limited reported unaudited standalone results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. Revenue from operations was Rs. 83.16 Cr, an 11.3% increase versus Rs. 74.71 Cr in Q2 FY26. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 9.88 Cr, up 14.8% from Rs. 8.61 Cr. Earnings per share were Rs. 4.27. Operating EBITDA margin improved 33 basis points to 16.0%. Company-owned and company-operated stores saw revenue growth of 24.5%. The company has no borrowings as of 30 September 2026. Inventory was Rs. 11.51 Cr. Management estimates December quarter revenue between Rs. 67 Cr and Rs. 70 Cr. This represents approximately 12.5% growth versus Rs. 60.90 Cr in the same quarter last year. The results were approved by the Board on 13 November 2026.

attchmntText: Ajax Engineering Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: Ajax Engineering Limited has issued a notice for a postal ballot to seek shareholder approval for the appointment of Mr. Shishir Joshipura, DIN 00574970, as a Non-Executive Independent Director. The resolution is placed for approval via remote e-voting through CDSL. The voting period commences on Sunday, 15 November 2026, at 9.00 a.m. IST and ends on Monday, 14 December 2026, at 5.00 p.m. IST. The cut-off date for eligibility is Friday, 06 November 2026. Mr. Pramod S M or Mr. Biswajit Ghosh of M/s. BMP & Co. LLP has been appointed as the Scrutinizer. The results of the postal ballot are expected to be announced on or before Wednesday, 16 December 2026. The appointment, if approved, would be for a term of five years from 17th September 2026 to 16th September 2031.

attchmntText: SRIT India Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: SRIT India Limited received an order from Ooredoo QPSC valued at Qatari Riyals ~50million, equivalent to ₹1,289.3 Million. The contract is for managed services regarding Electronic Health and Information Systems for Pharmacy and Drug Control Departments. The entity awarding the order is an international client. The agreement involves a two-year period for onboarding hospitals, clinics, health centers, and pharmacies, and a three-year period for managed services of the E-Health Eco System and National Drug Control roll-out operations. The contract is executed between SRIT’s branch in Doha QFC, Qatar, and Ooredoo QPSC. There is no interest held by the promoter group in the awarding entity, and the transaction does not constitute a related party transaction.

attchmntText: Update on our earlier intimation dated July 24, 2025 titled WABAG receives a Letter of Award for a 300 MLD Mega Sea Water Desalination Plant in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, worth about USD 272 Million (SAR 1,019 Million / INR 2,332 Crores)
voiceSummary: Va Tech Wabag Limited informs that the tender for a 300 MLD Mega Sea Water Desalination Plant in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, awarded to the company by the Saudi Water Authority, has been cancelled. The customer notified all tender participants via the Etimad portal that the cancellation is due to internal reasons attributable to the customer. The company had executed the contract on 23 July 2025, valued at approximately USD 272 Million. Va Tech Wabag is currently approaching the customer to understand the reasons in detail and determine the next course of action. This update relates to the earlier intimation dated 24 July 2025 regarding the award of the project.

attchmntText: Filing of RHP of Mahanadi Coalfields Limited (MCL), a wholly owned Subsidiary of CIL, with SEBI

attchmntText: Tamilnadu Telecommunication Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Tamilnadu Telecommunications Limited filed its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The company reported a net loss of 4,49,230 hundreds of rupees for the quarter. For the year-to-date period from 1st April 2026 to 30th September 2026, the net loss was 7,90,566 hundreds of rupees. Total income from operations was 250 hundreds of rupees for the quarter. Earnings per share were negative 0.98 rupees for the quarter. Paid-up equity share capital remained at 45,67,620.
